description.text: Pokémon Trading Card Game Classic, the English edition of a premium box designed with the Japanese design office nendo to be played for good with only its three decks, Venusaur & Lugia ex, Charizard & Ho-Oh ex and Blastoise & Suicune ex. It was sold at the Pokémon Center and local game stores from late 2023. Its cards carry no regulation mark, so cards from every era can share a deck, and apart from basic Energy they can't be used in official tournaments. Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise use their Base Set illustrations and keep their Energy Trans, Energy Burn and Rain Dance powers, now as Abilities, while the three Pokémon ex and a Pokémon Tool for each deck are new. This set is the Blastoise & Suicune ex deck: Blastoise's Rain Dance attaches Water Energy from the hand to your Water Pokémon as often as you like, Suicune ex's attack grows with the Water Energy on it, the biggest hitter of the three decks, and the new Tool Drops in the Ocean adds 100 damage to Blastoise's attack. The cloth-covered folding playmat holds the three decks and a toolbox of stackable damage counters, raised Poison and Burn markers and metal orbs that replace the coin: an orb rolled down its spiral that lands in a white-bordered hole counts as heads.
